requires.label: must be a Colorado resident
requires.quote: An individual must be a Resident of Colorado in order to qualify for Financial Assistance.

requires.label: emergency or medically necessary care only
requires.quote: offers Financial Assistance to those with an established need to receive emergency medical care and Medically Necessary hospital services

rules.label: 100% off at or below 250% FPL, if uninsured or under-insured
rules.quote: Patients approved for Financial Assistance with an annual Family Income of 250% of FPL guidelines or less will receive a 100% discount on gross charges

rules.label: facility discount (Appendix A) from 251% to 400% FPL, if uninsured or under-insured
rules.quote: Patients approved for Financial Assistance with an annual Family Income between 251% and 400% of FPL guidelines will receive a discount on gross charges

rules.label: 100% off when presumptively eligible (homeless, SNAP, WIC and similar)
rules.quote: Patients granted Presumptive Eligibility for Financial Assistance will receive a 100% discount on gross charges for care covered by this policy.

rules.label: catastrophic balance: bill over 50% of income plus financial resources
rules.quote: is greater than 50% of the Patient's total annual Family Income and Financial Resources combined.
